task: D1-FU2 — comptime diagnostic cascade (E1001 + E4005 for one root)
classification: REDUNDANT CASCADE — not a legitimate causal pair. E4005 restated a lowering symptom whose cause (an unresolved method) was already reported as E1001; it carried no independent failure.

reproducer.source:
const BAD: i32 = comptime { dec value = 1; value.not_a_method() };
fn main() -> i32 { return BAD; }
before: error[E1001]: Method `not_a_method` not found for type `Primitive(I32)`
error[E4005]: cannot evaluate comptime block: comptime type mismatch: MVIR invariant violated: unresolved method `not_a_method` reached lowering
after: error[E1001]: Method `not_a_method` not found for type `Primitive(I32)`

root_cause.detail: The comptime interpreter lowers the target to MVIR. When the generator reports an invariant (`generator.diagnostics` non-empty, e.g. `unresolved method ... reached lowering` at generator.rs:3259), the interpreter flattened those diagnostic MESSAGES into `ComptimeError::TypeMismatch("<messages joined>")`, discarding their code and span. The semantic caller (typechecker.rs `report_comptime_error`) then wrapped that generic error in a fresh `E4005`, i.e. provenance was lost at the comptime evaluation boundary and the failure was re-reported as a second, generic diagnostic.
root_cause.first_mismatch_layer: comptime evaluation boundary (interpreter -> semantic diagnostic), not the formatter

fix.approach: preserve provenance at the boundary instead of matching on 'E1001 exists'
changes: luna-mvir/src/interp.rs: return `ComptimeError::AlreadyDiagnosed` when generator.diagnostics is non-empty (no stringification)
luna-semantic typechecker `report_comptime_error`: `AlreadyDiagnosed` emits no diagnostic (the root cause is already in the list)
fix.independent_failures_preserved: the variant is only produced by the generator-invariant path; every interpreter-level failure (division by zero, unsupported operation, step/recursion limit, operand mismatch, unresolved projection) still returns its own variant and still reports E4005
